description:
A time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects.


- UI Improvement: Swapped Description and Project/Task positions on time entry cards to help users quickly identify similar entries.
- UI Improvement: Added a pointer cursor to all clickable controls.
- UI Improvement: Improved the projects picker placeholder text.
- Fix: Resolved several issues related to favorite projects (both in online and offline modes).
- Fix: Fixed an issue where unsynchronized entries were not visible in certain time zones.
- Fix: Fixed an issue where user could not duplicate entry on certain subdomains.
